content_sections.heading: About MGUG
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University Gorakhpur describes itself as a multidisciplinary university with a 200+ acre campus at Balapar, Gorakhpur. It offers higher education in fields including Medicine, Ayurveda, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Health & Life Science, Engineering & Technology, Allied & Healthcare and Management & Commerce. The notice mentions an upcoming 1,800-bed multi-specialty hospital on the campus, along with two functional multispecialty hospitals in Gorakhpur: Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (650+ beds) and Mahayogi Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (300+ beds).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first, and shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which college are these MGUG posts for?
faq.answer: All the teaching positions are for Shri Gorakshnath Medical College Hospital & Research Center, the medical college named in the advertisement.

faq.question: Q2. Which departments have Professor posts?
faq.answer: Professor posts are listed in 11 departments: Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Community Medicine, Pathology, Ophthalmology, ENT, General Medicine, Dermatology, Radiology, Orthopaedics and Paediatrics.

faq.question: Q3. Which departments have Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor posts are listed in 11 departments: Anatomy, Physiology, Pharmacology, Community Medicine, Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, General Medicine, Dermatology, Radiology, General Surgery, Psychiatry and Anaesthesiology.

faq.question: Q4. Which departments do not have a Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: Dermatology, Orthopaedics and Psychiatry are the three departments with no Senior Resident post in this advertisement. The other 16 departments list one.

faq.question: Q5. What should the email subject line be?
faq.answer: Follow the format with your own post and department, for example: Application for Senior Resident in Radiology, at SGMCHRC.

faq.question: Q6. What must I attach to the application?
faq.answer: The email needs three things: a detailed resume, supporting documents and a cover letter.

faq.question: Q7. Will every applicant be interviewed?
faq.answer: No. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can the University cancel this advertisement?
faq.answer: Yes. Advertisement No. MGUG/Recruitment/2026/10/006 can be withdrawn partly or wholly at any time, without any reason being given.
